chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from Yaʿqūb al-Sarrāj and ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, that when Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام was given allegiance after the killing of ʿUthmān, he ascended the pulpit and delivered a sermon which he mentioned, saying:
In it: “Indeed, your trial has returned to the condition it was in on the day when Allah sent His Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله.”

By the One who sent him with the truth, you will most certainly be thrown into confusion and most certainly be sifted thoroughly, until your lowest become your highest and your highest become your lowest, and those who had lagged behind will surely go ahead, while those who had gone ahead will surely fall behind.
By Allah, I did not conceal a mark, nor did I speak a single lie, and I had indeed been informed of this station and this day.”

key_terms.أَسْفَلُكُمْ: the lowest among you; those of low standing or rank
key_terms.أَعْلَاكُمْ: the highest among you; those of elevated standing or rank
key_terms.بَعَثَ: sent forth; referring to Allah sending the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.بَلِيَّتَكُمْ: your trial or affliction; the communal test facing the believers
key_terms.بِالْحَقِّ: with the truth; indicating the divine truthfulness of the mission
key_terms.لَتُبَلْبَلُنَّ: you will surely be thrown into turmoil and confusion
key_terms.لَتُغَرْبَلُنَّ: you will surely be sifted and separated through testing
key_terms.نُبِّئْتُ: I was informed; indicating prior divine or prophetic informing

ai.seo_question: How did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام describe the trials and upheaval facing the Muslim community after allegiance was given to him?
ai.summary: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام warns that after his assumption of leadership, the community would again face severe trial and testing like the earliest days of Islam. The sermon emphasizes upheaval, reversal of ranks, and divine examination, while affirming that he speaks with truthful foreknowledge of that moment.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Yaqoub Al Sarraj and Ali Bin Raib,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>: ‘When Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> was pledged allegiance to after the killing of Usman, he<sup>asws</sup> ascended the Pulpit and addressed with a sermon, he (Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>) mentioned, saying therein: ‘
Indeed! Your trials have returned as if these were on the day Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Sent His<sup>azwj</sup> Prophet<sup>saww</sup>.

By the One<sup>azwj</sup> Who Sent him<sup>saww</sup> with the Truth, you will be tried with trials and you would be sifted with a sifting until your lower ones would turn to be your higher ones and your higher ones, your lower ones, and your forwards ones who were ahead would be left behind, and those who were left behind would precede.
By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I<sup>asws</sup> have not concealed and (have) specified, and I<sup>asws</sup> did not lie with a lie, and I<sup>asws</sup> had been Informed with this place and this day’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Hassan ibn Mahbub from ya‘qub al-Sarraj and Ali ibn Ri’ab from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following. “When people pledged allegiance to Amir al-Mu’minin (a.s.) after the assassination of ‘Uthman he addressed the people from the pulpit and delivered a sermon (that abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) mentioned).
In this sermon he has said, “The time for your trial has returned in the same conditions as those of the day Allah sent his Prophet (s.a.).

By the One Who has sent him with the truth that you will suffer hideous confusions, will be sifted thoroughly and turned upside down. Of the contestants those who were behind of others will overtake those who were ahead and those who were ahead of others (because of their shortcomings) will be left behind of those who once were behind of others.
By Allah I have not concealed any of the marks therein nor have I spoken a lie. I was certainly, told about this place and this day.”
